task.description:
Rework of the translation after the gate FAIL (gate pass 1 of 3; findings in handoffs/TRANSL-20261025-01/step-07-release-validator.json, step-07b-release-validator.json and step-07c-release-validator.json, result.issues). Fix exactly these, keep everything else; the meaning of rules must not change.
1. docs/workflows/handoffs.md "Time" (about lines 203-204): the rule says "unknown" is written, but tools/src/handoffs/times.js accepts only «неизвестно». Write «неизвестно» ("unknown"). Same for any other place where a literal that a tool or another file reads was translated.
2. handoffs.md about line 127: the orch_check verdict «FAIL принят» must stay Russian with an English gloss (orchestrator.md and 42 handoffs use it).
3. Cross references: verdict-executor.md line 39 -> WF-06 heading "Rework loop"; test-runner.md line 36 -> tools/README.md heading "Check"; orchestrator.md lines 233-234 must quote CLAUDE.md as it now reads ("ORCH writes by itself only this (a closed list):"). Re-check every cross reference of this kind after your edits.
4. orchestrator.md lines 128-129: a wrapped line begins with a dash and became an extra Markdown bullet (111 list items against 110 in the tag): rejoin it so the list item count equals the tag.
5. docs/anti-patterns.md: restore the Cyrillic identifiers that were turned into Latin: AP-015 lines about Д7 (Д7, not D7), AP-068 Ф7 (not F7), AP-059 "WEB-15 (б)" (not (b)); a Latin gloss in brackets is fine. Then search all translated files for other identifiers that point at Cyrillic names in unchanged files (table rows, test titles, section labels) and restore them too.
6. Placeholders: use one form. Check tools/src and tools/test for any tool or test that reads `<вне проекта>`; if none reads it, use `<outside the project>` in CLAUDE.md (line 83), AP-022, AP-050, AP-069. In README.md lines 231 and 234 use `<Sai repository address>`.
7. Small wording: WF-02 line 350 "the gate of step 8 is closed without the signature" -> "stays closed (not passed) without the signature"; AP-041 keep the window label «Просмотр истории» with the gloss "History view"; AP-073 "finish accounting" -> "finish the bookkeeping"; "foreign errors", "at the order of ORCH", "much data" -> plain English; audit-planner.md line 55 restore the original meaning of «с полосой Critical» from the tag (do not guess; if unclear, say so in issues).
8. Unify standard headings across the 37 role files to one wording each (what to hand over / boundary with / flaky / score): choose the most frequent wording; run the full check after, because tests may read some headings (REQ-003 AC2 reads "Quality bar — binding").
9. docs/requirements.yaml: about 14 done requirements (REQ-009, 010, 011, 013, 035, 038, 042, 044, 045, 048, 050, 052, 061, 068; WF-06/WF-07 lines about 375 and 454) quote old Russian headings and phrases of the translated files. Change ONLY the quoted heading or phrase to the English one that now exists (same fact), as a micro-amendment per docs/workflows/WF-01-requirement.md, and write the status-history event per that rule (reason: decisions/0080). Do not change any status or the meaning of a criterion. Search the whole file for other criteria that quote the translated files.
10. decisions/0080-english-instructions.md: add the sections Question, Options, Basis (see decisions/README.md for what a decision needs; Basis = «Основание»), and a new numbered item "Literals that tools and files read stay as they are": list every Russian literal that code in tools/src reads from instruction or handoff files (for example «неизвестно», «FAIL принят», the defect fields Статус/Серьёзность/Найдено, Закрыто, the STATE.md heading written by contract.js) — find them by searching tools/src, give the file for each.
Do not touch tools/test (another agent re-points the FS-16 guard). No git checkout/reset/stash/clean, no commits, do not run prettier on .md outside tools/. Before close: cd tools && npm run handoffs-check and npm run traces, then npm run check (only the 11 known reds may remain). In result list each item 1-10 with what you changed and where.
